headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when history was made as FTR vs. The Young Bucks contested the very first AAA World Tag Team Titles match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.00 ? a war that left everything in the ring. A rematch of a modern classic ? both teams left it all in the ring for the ROH/AAA Tag Team Titles, in a show that also saw Samoa Joe's AEW in-ring debut, in a stacked night widely praised as one of the best episodes of the year.

On a Sunday in 2025, back when Kenny Omega vs. Mike Bailey vs. Ricochet clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynasty, rated 9.14 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. Mike Bailey was challenging for gold for the very first time. Omega and Bailey briefly aligned against Ricochet before Omega finished with an avalanche One Winged Angel, retaining the International Title in a match Tony Schiavone called one for the ages.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Penta El Zero M vs. Komander met for the very first time, headlining the show on Collision, rated 7.43 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2025, gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Adam Cole vs. Daniel Garcia battled it out in a No Time Limit match, appearing on Dynasty, rated 5.65 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Cole capitalized on Garcia's frustration, hitting a pair of Panama Sunrises and a running knee to win his first singles championship in AEW, the TNT Title.

Looking back to 2025, when the ROH World Heavyweight Title changed hands as Bandido vs. Chris Jericho battled it out, appearing on Dynasty, rated 4.64 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Bandido's family exposed Jericho's hidden baseball bat to force a restart, and Bandido capitalized with the 21 Plex to win the ROH World Championship while keeping his mask.
It was 2025 when Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. Rated FTR put the AEW World Trios Titles on the line, appearing on Dynasty, rated 6.91. It was the first title opportunity of Rated FTR's career.
